MATCH (ceo:Person)-[:HAS_PARENT]->(parent:Person)<-[:HAS_PARENT]-(investor:Person),
      (org:Organization)-[:HAS_CEO]->(ceo),
      (org)-[:HAS_INVESTOR]->(investor)
RETURN org.name
details: TypeQL uses not{} but Cypher has no negation
